definitions.asStored: Graph exactly as the dataset stores it. Polyline interior vertices are degree-2 nodes. Inter-floor links are excluded from per-floor graphs.
definitions.drawnUnion: Vertices merged within a 0.1 m lattice cell (first original coordinate kept), segments split at any vertex within 0.15 m of their interior, duplicate segments removed. No junction is added where segments cross; such crossings are counted.
definitions.destinationNode: Mappedin: a space's destinationNodes; Situm: a node within 3 m of an indoor POI (Situm binds destinations at run time); ours: arrival:* nodes.
definitions.doorNode: Mappedin: nodes of door connections; Situm: none; ours: door:*/opening:* portal nodes.
definitions.deadEnd: Degree-1 node; destination dead end when it is a destination or door node, otherwise bare. Stub = bare dead end whose only segment is < 0.5 m.
definitions.chains: Maximal degree-2 chains between anchors (degree != 2). Spine: junction to junction; branch: junction to dead end; destination branch: branch whose dead end is a destination/door node.
definitions.branchAttachmentAngleDeg: Acute angle (0-90) between the branch heading (to the point 1 m along it) and the spine axis at its junction (most collinear pair of incident spine chains, headings 1 m along).
definitions.branchSpacingAlongSpineM: Distance along a spine stroke between consecutive junctions that carry at least one branch.
definitions.spineStroke: Spine chains joined through junctions by the straightest continuation (deflection < 30 deg, greedy best first).
definitions.spineTurnsOver5DegPer100m: Heading changes > 5 deg between consecutive segments (>= 0.05 m) along spine strokes, per 100 m of stroke.
definitions.spineStraightRunShare: Share of spine-stroke length in runs >= 5 m whose segments stay within 3 deg of the run's first heading.
definitions.spineJogsPer100m: Net-zero sideways jogs along spine strokes: two consecutive turns > 5 deg of opposite sign, <= 3 m apart, summing to < 5 deg (rounded corners, whose turns share a sign, are not jogs).
definitions.zigzag: Turn > 120 deg where either adjacent segment is <= 2 m, along any chain (taken from asStored for the headline, since the union collapses out-and-back spikes into stubs).
definitions.cyclomatic: E - V + C over nodes with degree >= 1.
